A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species'''<ref name="AOTC" /> of [[Near-Human|Near-Humans]]<ref name="Who'sWho" />&mdash;a classification of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] that genetically differed from [[Human/Legends|Humans]]<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-7-the-grand-army-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 7 &mdash; The Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>&mdash;existed during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="DB" /> Members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] identified with at least the female [[Gender/Legends|gender]]<ref name="DB" /> and could possess [[Color/Legends|blue]]-green skin,<ref name="Who'sWho" /> black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="DB" />

[[Ame Llom]] was a member of the species who resided on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="DB" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the end of the Republic, Llom frequented the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="DB" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of her homeworld.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AOTC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Llom spent [[Time/Legends|time]] at the club talking and laughing with a Human while the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] hid in the club.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|With her blue-green skin, Ame Llom is a near-human alien of a species not yet described in the Expanded Universe.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Who'sWho" />}}
The species first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> in scenes shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]], on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The species was revealed when the extra portraying Ame Llom, in costume, introduced the fourth episode of ''[[on location]]'', a behind-the-scenes series for the then upcoming film. The episode, "The Man Behind C-3PO," released on [[August 22]], 2000.<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/archive.html|text=''on location'' archive}}</ref> Author [[Daniel Wallace]] wrote that the species had not been identified within the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] in his article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]," published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''<ref name="Who'sWho" /> on [[April 6]], [[2004]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref>
